svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Microservices e-commerce on Amazon EKS
svg.desc: Microservices e-commerce on Amazon EKS. 20 components in 7 groups. Connections: Shoppers to Amazon Route 53 (DNS query); Shoppers to Amazon CloudFront (HTTPS); AWS WAF to Amazon CloudFront; Amazon CloudFront to Application Load Balancer (origin requests); Application Load Balancer to Storefront; Storefront to Cart; Storefront to Catalog; Storefront to Orders; Storefront to Payments; Cart to Amazon ElastiCache; Orders to Amazon Aurora; Storefront to Amazon Cognito (verify tokens); Amazon EKS cluster to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (pull images); Amazon EKS cluster to AWS Secrets Manager (credentials); Catalog to Amazon DynamoDB (products); Catalog to Assets bucket (product images); Orders to Order events (OrderPlaced); Order events to Shipping jobs; Shipping to Shipping jobs (poll).

text.tspan: Edge services in front of an ALB and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service microservices, with data stores, order events and platform services
